summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...` and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: D })` against a bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled/obfuscated blob with a rotating string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shift routine over a ~1500-element constant table `n7gIxM`) and hex-mangled identifiers, headed by `// @bun @bun-cjs`. The advertised package purpose is a small React micro-frontend that registers a web component (`dist/index.js`); shipping a multi-hundred-KB obfuscated payload that is executed with a freshly-downloaded second language runtime at install time is unrelated to that purpose. Executing the payload under Bun rather than Node bypasses Node-based install-time scanners, and the obfuscation prevents static resolution of the payload's behavior. The payload runs with the installer's privileges before any application code is imported.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
